name: B10-0145/2024 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision authorising the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified cotton COT102 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to allow imports of a genetically modified cotton called COT102. The cotton is engineered to make its own insect poison and to carry a gene that resists an antibiotic. Parliament says the safety checks left open questions about harm to people, animals and the environment, and that Member States did not back the plan. Parliament cannot block the plan itself; it can only ask.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to withdraw the plan and send a new draft.
- **Who it affects:** Companies importing this cotton and its food and feed products, and shoppers and farmers using them.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw, change or keep its plan.
